title: Croatian Chilli and Sushi Wrap
description: A spicy and savory wrap filled with Croatian sausage, sushi rice, and chilli peppers.
instructions: Grill the Croatian sausage until browned and cooked through.
Cook the sushi rice according to package instructions.
Slice the grilled sausage and set aside.
In a pan, heat the sliced chilli peppers over medium heat.
Add the cooked sushi rice to the pan and stir to combine with the chilli peppers.
Warm the nutty tortilla wrap in the oven or in a dry pan.
Assemble the wrap by placing the sausage and rice mixture onto one half of the tortilla.
Drizzle with soy sauce and fold the tortilla in half.
